extraction: Claude DevFleet mission DAG and auto-dispatch workflow. plan_project(prompt) returns project_id + list of missions with depends_on chains and auto_dispatch=true. Show plan with mission titles, types, dependency chain to user. Dispatch first mission (empty depends_on). Remaining missions auto-dispatch as dependencies complete (auto_dispatch=true). Poll get_mission_status or get_dashboard() until all missions reach terminal state (completed, failed, cancelled). get_report(mission_id) for each terminal mission - summarize successes, call out failures with errors and next steps. Manual workflow: create_project -> create_mission (auto_dispatch=true) for root mission -> create_mission for subsequent tasks with depends_on=[root_mission_id] -> dispatch_mission on first -> get_report when done -> create_mission for Review with depends_on=[impl_mission_id], auto_dispatch=true. Concurrency: 3 concurrent agents default (DEVFLEET_MAX_AGENTS). Missions queue when slots full, auto-dispatch as slots free.
